# ghost_organization_pinned_repositories (Resource)

Manages the repositories pinned to an organization's profile page, in the order they're shown. The resource owns the whole list: there is one per organization, any repository pinned outside Terraform is unpinned on the next apply, and you must be an admin of the organization. Up to 6 of the organization's own repositories can be pinned, private ones included (only people who can read a private repository see it pinned). **Destroying the resource unpins every repository.** Ghost unpins a repository when it's deleted. Pinned repositories of a user's profile can't be managed: Ghost's API has no route for them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ghost_repository" "api" {
  name  = "api"
  owner = "my-org"
}

resource "ghost_repository" "web" {
  name       = "Web App"
  owner      = "my-org"
  visibility = "public"
}

# The organization's whole list of pins, in display order (at most 6).
# Refer to slug rather than name: Ghost matches slugs exactly, and the slug of
# "Web App" is "web-app". Destroying the resource unpins every repository.
resource "ghost_organization_pinned_repositories" "example" {
  organization = "my-org"
  repositories = [
    ghost_repository.web.slug,
    ghost_repository.api.slug,
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) The organization's slug, matched case-insensitively and kept as configured. Changing it to another organization forces a new resource (which unpins the old organization's repositories); changing only its case doesn't.
- `repositories` (List of String) The slugs of the organization's repositories to pin, in display order, at most 6. Ghost matches slugs exactly, and a slug is the repository's name in lower case with spaces turned into hyphens, so refer to `ghost_repository.<name>.slug` rather than `name`. A renamed repository stays pinned under its new slug. Leave the list empty to unpin everything.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The organization's slug, in lower case.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Pinned repositories are imported by the organization's slug.
terraform import ghost_organization_pinned_repositories.example my-org
```
